subject: Internal Error 58: File already exists - Loss of file and analysis

messages.author: 8028d75f27f06548
messages.subject: Internal Error 58: File already exists - Loss of file and analysis
parts:
Dear Wonderful Distance Sampling Team
Please can you help with this query.

Intermittently, when i exit the Distance 7.1 program, I receive the following message

Could not compact database because the following error occurred: Internal Error number 58.   Internal Error description.   "File already exists"

When i then go to my Windows folder , the Distance .dst file is completely gone.   along with associated recent work.  

Please do you have any ideas how I can retrieve such?
Or at least prevent this error from occurring anymore?   

Thank you so much.  Kind regards, Carl

messages.author: f2122b34f1aa6e95
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Internal Error 58: File already exists - Loss of file and analysis
parts:
Carl

Good to hear from you.  That is an error I'm not familiar with.

By any chance does it arise because you are working with files on a removable medium (such as a thumb drive or cloud storage)?  It is only a guess, but I wonder if the error arises because of latency in writing of the files.  If see there is any truth to my hypothesis, conduct the experiment of running a project in a "standard" file location, such as the default "My Distance Projects" folder of your C:\ drive.  If the error 58 arises even when working on a local hard disk, then my theory is disproved.

Let us know what happens.

parts: Eric, Thank you for your kind, swift response.   Your advice was amazingly helpful.  Previously, as you suggested, all my work was being stored on Dropbox.   This seems to have created the issue.   When i then moved my work to my laptop hard drive, without Dropbox, it stopped occurring.  So now solved.  I have tried it a few times since then, and all fine.  Thank you so much.   And kind regards,   Carl
